summary: smoke: OpenVPN UDP 1194: P_CONTROL_HARD_RESET_CLIENT_V2 (frame 1) + SERVER_V2 (frame 2) + 10 P_DATA_V2 (frames 3-12); sessionid persists across the dialog

notes: opcode byte at offset 42 (eth14+ip20+udp8): 0x38 = (0x07<<3)|keyid 0 (HARD_RESET_CLIENT_V2), 0x48 = (0x09<<3)|0 (P_DATA_V2), verified against /tmp/probe-iana/openvpn.pcap
default DataPacketCount=5 per direction -> 10 data frames + 2 control = 12 frames; tshark prints opcode in hex (0x07/0x08/0x09), keyid decimal 0
sessionid is run-random (rand.Uint64) but generated once per flow -> same on frames 1-2 (same_as_packet); peerid run-random but constant across data frames (same_as_packet)
udp.port 1194 is IANA-registered to openvpn -> auto-parses, no decode_as needed; TLS handshake bytes inside control frames are also random-ish (session-id based), only structural assertions
